description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Breya's Apprentice, adding {C}{C}.
Breya's Apprentice dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Breya's Apprentice from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Breya's Apprentice enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
